claim_boundary: The result establishes necessity of a persistent jointly writable state under the frozen synthetic architecture and resource rules. It does not prove that no possible communication protocol can emulate a workspace; recurrent message-state and external logs are explicitly classified as workspace-equivalent persistent memory.

seed_results.interpretation: Only mechanisms retaining a persistent jointly updated task state solve the online composition. A recurrent message-state succeeds because it is functionally a distributed workspace. A complete external message log also succeeds, but that log is an external persistent workspace rather than a nonworkspace counterexample.
